transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we begin our finalization meeting for the 'Tide Memory' installation, I'd like to go through our standard process. I need each of you — our technical producer, rights counsel, accessibility coordinator, and guest liaison — to report any confirmed production requirements you have before I sign off on the final exhibition and opening-night package. Let's start with the technical producer: what confirmed requirements do you have regarding the eight stations and 15-minute sessions?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a confirmed production requirement from my equipment test yesterday. The installation can only run reliably on exactly six stations, not eight as currently planned. Additionally, each headset requires a five-minute sanitation reset between sessions, which affects our 15-minute session structure — we'll need to account for that reset time. I recorded all of this in the technical worksheet after yesterday's systems check, but I should note that worksheet hasn't been attached to the festival master brief yet, so I want to make sure it's formally on record here before you sign off.

transcript.text: Mara, I have a confirmed rights requirement to report before you sign off. I received the countersigned license addendum from the distributor this morning. The festival license for 'Tide Memory' permits exactly three public showings and prohibits visitor recording. These limits have not yet been entered into the event contract summary, so I want them formally on record here. This directly conflicts with the current draft plan's allowance of unrestricted recording by visitors, and we'll need to address the showing limit as well.

transcript.text: Mara, I have a confirmed accessibility requirement to report before you sign off. My accessibility review — completed with the access consultant on Tuesday — requires exactly two captioned companion tablets and a seated orientation before each session. The resulting access specification is still in my department's review folder and hasn't been attached to the festival master brief yet, so I want it formally on record here.
